summary: Wave 3 Pre-Launch Increment A backend verified. Created new pytest file test_wave3_prelaunch_A_driver_verification.py with 22 tests covering GET /api/admin/drivers/{driver_id}, POST /api/admin/users/{id}/{approve,suspend,request-changes}, POST /api/auth/me/resubmit-verification, and GET /api/auth/me exposing changes_requested_reason/changes_requested_doc_types/suspension_reason. Full state-machine test (approve -> suspend -> approve -> request-changes -> resubmit) passes with verification_history audit trail correctly appended at each step. Backward compat regression: all 19 tests in test_wave3_phaseB_search_and_driver_dashboard.py still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: resubmit-verification correctly $unset changes_requested_reason and changes_requested_doc_types on transition to pending — confirmed via /api/auth/me follow-up.

admin_driver_detail schema matches spec {user, documents, fleet, stats}. Documents query already filters active=True. 400 vs 404 discrimination (unknown id -> 404, non-driver id -> 400) works correctly.
request-changes correctly rejects reason < 10 chars (strips whitespace before length check).
Suspend endpoint accepts both {reason: '...'} body and empty body (Optional[AdminUserActionPayload]) — both paths tested and OK.
verification_history entries include by_admin_id, action, reason, previous_status, at — good audit shape.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused seeded driver1@cargoone.com; module-scoped fixture resets driver to active on setup and best-effort re-approves on teardown so subsequent test suites start from a clean state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_wave3_prelaunch_A_driver_verification.py leaves seeded driver in 'active' state on module teardown (best-effort approve). If a later suite depends on driver being in 'pending' status, it should force-transition explicitly. New optional user fields on /api/auth/me: changes_requested_reason, changes_requested_doc_types, suspension_reason.
